map.根据目标EC值计算肥料母液配比、注肥速率与养分浓度: Compute fertilizer stock ratio, injection rate, and nutrient concentration from a target EC value
map.净 EC = 目标EC − 水源EC；母液浓度 = 净EC ÷ 肥料EC系数；灌: Net EC = target EC - source EC; stock concentration = net EC / fertilizer EC factor; irrigation volume = emitter flow x emitter count x (minutes / 60); total fertilizer = stock concentration x irrigation volume / 1000
map.按 EC 差值确定需由肥料贡献的盐分浓度：净 EC 除以所选肥料的 EC 系数（: Use the EC difference to set the salt concentration contributed by fertilizer: net EC divided by the chosen fertilizer EC factor (EC per unit concentration) gives stock concentration (g/L). Irrigation volume comes from emitter flow x count x duration; multiply the two for total fertilizer, then split by N/P/K content. Stock preparation uses the set injection ratio (1:X) to back-calculate stock concentration and volume.
map.按目标 EC/pH 与作物阶段 N-P-K 比例配制母液。: Prepare stock by target EC/pH and crop-stage N-P-K ratio.
map.钙肥与磷/硫分罐防沉淀。: Keep calcium separate from phosphorus/sulfur tanks to prevent precipitation.
map.用于设施蔬菜精准随水施肥。: Used for precise fertigation of facility vegetables.
map.目标 EC 2.2、pH 6.0，母液 A（N-K）EC 25、母液 B（P-C: Target EC 2.2, pH 6.0, stock A (N-K) EC 25, stock B (P-Ca-Mg) EC 18. Field EC 2.2 needs A diluted 25/2.2=11.4x and B 18/2.2=8.2x injected separately to avoid direct A-B mixing and precipitation.
map.A、B 母液为什么不能混？: Why cannot stocks A and B be mixed?
map.含钙的 B 液与含磷酸根/硫酸根的 A 液混合生成磷酸钙、硫酸钙沉淀，堵塞滴头。: Calcium-bearing stock B and phosphate/sulfate-bearing stock A form calcium phosphate and calcium sulfate precipitates that clog emitters. They must be diluted separately and join only in the main line.
map.EC 高了好还是低了好？: Is higher or lower EC better?
map.随作物与阶段。苗期低（1.0~1.5）、结果期高（2.0~2.5），过高烧根、过: It depends on crop and stage. Low in seedling (1.0~1.5), high in fruiting (2.0~2.5); too high burns roots, too low causes stretching. Follow the variety stage table and fine-tune by growth.
